rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in an uncomfortable or uneasy manner.

example.english: I stood uneasily on stage waiting to be called.
example.traditional: 我唔自在咁企喺台上面等叫名。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi6 zoi6 gam3 kei5 hai2 toi1 soeng6 min6 dang2 giu3 ming4

rows.note: Use this when the uneasiness is clearly anxious or apprehensive rather than merely awkward.

example.english: They opened the medical report uneasily.
example.traditional: 佢哋忐忑不安咁打開份體檢報告。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 taan2 tik1 bat1 on1 gam3 daa2 hoi1 fan6 tai2 gim2 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when someone is uneasy because they are worried about something.

example.english: I kept looking at my phone uneasily, waiting for my mum to reply.
example.traditional: 我心掛掛咁望住個電話，等阿媽覆我。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sam1 gwaa3 gwaa3 gam3 mong6 zyu6 go3 din6 waa2 dang2 aa3 maa1 fuk1 ngo5
